CHECKED ANYWAY, decisively: re-running the .do logic on DA2938 (N=1437, id = row number, 98/99 set missing, rows with missing resp dropped, no other recode or reversal; .cache/spain_2012_entrepreneurship_values/rebuild.R) reproduces the live table exactly -- 14258 rows and 1436 ids both, id-item-resp multisets identical (0/0 set differences, 0 duplicate id-item keys), cov_age 0 mismatches, cov_sex exported as its Stata value label (Hombre = raw 1 on 7277 rows, Mujer = raw 2 on 6981, 0 off-diagonal). N.S./N.C. dropped by the .do: p801 7/0, p802 1/0, p803 1/0, p804 17/4, p805 14/0, p806 13/1, p807 1/0, p808 15/11, p809 1/2, p810 17/7 (112 cells); no 0-code filter, asked of all 1437. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (10 items, resp 0..10). Live per-item levels: p802 has no 1 or 2 and p807 no 2 responses; their option rows are still shipped because the scale was offered to everyone. text_source=study_materials: item_text = the ten P.8 grid rows read from the scanned questionnaire page 2 rendered at 250 dpi and read visually (no OCR engine), cross-checked exactly against the ES2938 variable labels. instructions = the P.8 lead-in verbatim, asserted an exact substring of the Es2938pdf.pdf marginals text layer (PREGUNTA 8, two lines joined, whitespace collapsed) and agreeing with the questionnaire image; the interviewer direction '(MOSTRAR TARJETA B).' (show card B) is not respondent-read text and is not shipped; 'P.8', the 'Escala 00 - 10 / NS / NC' grid header and column markers not shipped. Placed in instructions because it frames every item of this single-grid, single-section table (batch_474-476 CIS single-grid precedent); section_prompt blank. RESP: CIS codes stored unchanged, 0 = Muy poco importante ... 10 = Muy importante, higher = MORE important (the opposite direction to the 1-4 importance grids P.7/P.14a in sibling tables). language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 2938 in Spanish only, so the English in instructions_translated, item_text_translated and option_text_translated was written by IRW (the gender-inclusive 'muchos/as amigos/as' is rendered 'many friends'); an issues-page entry is owed once live. RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, every CIS survey year, irw#2381); CIS's own questionnaire. No register row written. Siblings (spain_2012_entrepreneurship_* in batches 474-476; spain_2025_inequality_* in this round) not touched.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only; resp runs 0 = 'Muy poco importante' (very unimportant) to 10 = 'Muy importante' (very important), with only the two endpoints labelled on the show card, and 'don't know'/no-answer responses (under 2% per item) were dropped to missing by the IRW processing script.
